accounts.name: global
docs: Settings for this quote; read only for the buy pause.

accounts.name: to
docs: Any quote token account the creator owns.

accounts.name: to
docs: Any quote token account the treasury owns.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote this coin trades against; picks which settings apply.

accounts.name: amm_config
docs: The pool config this coin will graduate into; must still accept new pools.

accounts.name: graduator
docs: Graduation also needs the graduator's launchpad permission and the pool
program's creation-fee account. Checking them here means a coin can't
launch, sell out and then find it can't graduate.

accounts.name: mint
docs: New mint keypair (lets the client pick a vanity address).

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: `init_if_needed`: anyone can create this address once they see the mint
address, which must not block the launch.

accounts.name: graduator_base
docs: The graduator's accounts for this coin and for the quote. `init_if_needed`
because anyone can create them first; doing so changes nothing.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint (wSOL or USDC).

accounts.name: amm_config
docs: Pool config in QF's pool program that graduated coins use.

accounts.name: global
docs: Settings for this quote; read only for the buy pause.

errors.name: InsufficientCurveTokens

errors.name: PoolConfigDisabled

errors.name: PoolAmountMismatch

errors.name: DefaultKey

types.name: AmmConfig
docs: Holds the current owner of the factory

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump to identify PDA

fields.name: disable_create_pool
docs: Status to control if new pool can be create

fields.name: index
docs: Config index

fields.name: trade_fee_rate
docs: The trade fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: protocol_fee_rate
docs: The protocol fee

fields.name: fund_fee_rate
docs: The fund fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: create_pool_fee
docs: Fee for create a new pool

fields.name: protocol_owner
docs: Address of the protocol fee owner

fields.name: fund_owner
docs: Address of the fund fee owner

fields.name: creator_fee_rate
docs: The pool creator fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: creator_fee_share_rate
docs: The share of the creator fee retained by the protocol, denominated in
hundredths of a bip (10^-6). Zero means the creator receives the whole creator fee.
Overridden by a `CreatorFeeShare` account when one exists for the pool creator.

fields.name: padding
docs: padding

types.name: CurveReopened
docs: A sold-out coin that did not graduate in time went back to Trading.

fields.name: to
docs: The token account paid.

fields.name: creator
docs: true: the creator's share; false: the platform's share.

types.name: Global
docs: Settings for launches against one quote mint, at [GLOBAL_SEED, quote_mint].
SOL-quoted and USDC-quoted coins each have their own.

fields.name: admin
docs: Can change the config, fee recipient and pause flags, and propose a new admin.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Wallet whose quote token account receives platform fees.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote mint these launches trade against (wSOL or USDC).

fields.name: amm_config
docs: Pool program config every graduated coin's pool uses.

fields.name: create_paused
docs: Blocks new launches only.

fields.name: buy_paused
docs: Emergency stop for buys on every coin. Selling, graduation and fee
claims never pause, so a pause can stop new money but never trap anyone.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Admin hand-over is two steps: the admin proposes, the new key accepts
(`accept_admin`), so a mistyped key can never take over. Default = none.

fields.name: admin
docs: In `initialize`, the admin. In `update_global`, a different key here
proposes it as the next admin; the current admin's key cancels a proposal.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote mint and pool config copied from the global config at creation,
so a launch's rules never change after it starts.

fields.name: real_quote
docs: Quote paid into the curve (net of fees) and not yet paid back out.

fields.name: base_sold
docs: Curve tokens currently held by buyers.

fields.name: platform_fees
docs: Platform fees held in the quote vault, not yet claimed.

fields.name: creator_fees
docs: Creator fees held in the quote vault, not yet claimed.

fields.name: pool
docs: Pool address, set at graduation.

fields.name: completed_at
docs: When the curve sold out (0 while trading). See GRADUATION_GRACE_SECS.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: The rules every new launch copies at creation. Changing the global config
never changes a launch that already exists.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Total tokens minted, in base units. Minted once, mint authority revoked.

fields.name: curve_supply
docs: Tokens sold on the curve. The rest (total - curve) seeds the pool.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Starting virtual quote reserve of the curve, in quote base units.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Starting virtual base reserve of the curve, in base units.

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Fee on every curve trade, in bps of the quote amount.

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Share of the trade fee that goes to the coin's creator, in bps.

fields.name: graduation_fee
docs: Quote kept by the platform when the coin graduates.

types.name: Permission
docs: Holds the current owner of the factory

fields.name: authority
docs: authority

fields.name: padding
docs: padding

fields.name: quote_amount
docs: Quote the trader paid (buy) or received (sell), fees included in a buy.

fields.name: real_quote
docs: State after the trade, so indexers never need to recompute it.
